title: Biscuit Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this biscuit tagine combines the warmth of spices with the flaky texture of biscuits.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with cumin and chili powder

instructions: Roll out the yeasty dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out small squares of dough for the biscuit topping.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with crumbled biscuit.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the biscuit is golden brown.
